caveats: No per-cell MHW was detected in this region over 2012-06-01..2012-08-31: no sea cell reached 5 consecutive days with SST >= its (smoothed) 90th-percentile threshold; the longest hot streak was 3 consecutive days. Closest near-miss: cell at 57.36N, 9.66E had hot days 2012-07-05/06 and 2012-07-08/09/10, split by 2012-07-07 which was 0.54 K below threshold, so no >=5-day MHW (and hence no regional event) formed. All 3314 sea cells (of 3600 grid cells) were finite on every target day and every baseline-window day (1991-12-27..2003-01-05), so no missing-value handling affected thresholds. Note: numpy 2.x method='hazen' (used as specified) differs by up to ~0.004 K from MATLAB's default 'linear' interpolation for these n=121 pools; the final mask and events were verified identical under both conventions. Data for the analysed periods were read from s2z/sst_s2.nc (covers 1982-01-01..2023-12-31); the s1z daily files only cover 1982-01-01..1984-09-26.
